verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any user-defined rule or trigger system that fires actions automatically on events. Project-level assistant assignment (jan-docs-12) is a static default setting, not an event trigger. Autonomous agent tasks (jan-docs-13/14) are user-initiated work, not rule-based automation. MCP tool calls require manual approval of each call. Event-based automation is a fair question for an AI assistant app, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
